title: Learning journal
instructions: Describe what changed in your understanding and why.

title: Personal progress review
instructions: Write what worked, what did not, and what you would change.

title: Values check-in
instructions: Explain how the choice connects to your own values.

title: Investigate water quality
description: Find evidence about local drinking water.
instructions: Compare published reports and cite reliable sources.

title: Explore solar energy
instructions: Consult three references and summarize their findings.

title: Compare transit options
description: Investigate ways people travel to work.
instructions: Collect published travel statistics and assess the evidence.

title: Team planning circle
description: Make a shared plan with your teammates.
instructions: Discuss priorities, negotiate roles, and reach agreement together.

title: Peer feedback workshop
instructions: Exchange drafts, give feedback, and agree on revisions as a group.

title: Community consensus
description: Work together on a neighborhood decision.
instructions: Listen to each member and jointly choose priorities.

title: Design a poster
description: Produce an original community event poster.
instructions: Sketch a layout and make the final visual design.

title: Compose a song
description: Make an original piece of music.
instructions: Write lyrics and a melody, then record your composition.

title: Build a prototype
description: Develop a new rainwater collector model.
instructions: Draw your design and construct a working prototype.

title: Fraction drills
instructions: Solve twenty fraction problems and repeat those you missed.

title: Rehearse a speech
instructions: Deliver the same speech three times, adjusting pacing each time.

title: Guitar chord repetitions
instructions: Repeat the progression slowly and increase speed when accurate.

title: Visit a wetland
instructions: Walk the trail and observe wildlife in its natural habitat.

title: Museum field visit
instructions: Tour the museum and examine the artifacts on display.

title: Job shadow day
description: Experience the daily work of a carpenter.
instructions: Accompany a carpenter on site and observe their routine.

title: Explain composting
instructions: Demonstrate the steps and answer learners questions.

title: Tutor a classmate
instructions: Explain the method, show an example, and check their understanding.

title: Lead a coding lesson
instructions: Demonstrate a loop and guide learners through their first program.
